name: bigram-table-scan
description: Hashes every using value once against dictionaries of the master values; sorts eligible using records into (state, city) blocks; encodes each block's bigrams once with inverted lists, so a master record's bigram counts are sums over its own bigrams' lists; evaluates reclink2's comparator, weights and float32 rounding operation by operation, vectorized over chunks of candidates; single-threaded Numba.
